name: Deckle-edged cut-paper sheet
description: Seeded cut-paper silhouette (hills, peaks, waves, clouds, disc, niche, arch, flames, lotus or rect) with a geometric deckle edge, paper fibre, a light cut-edge line and a soft lifted shadow.

implementation.api: Studio.kit.mythic.sheet(parent, {shape, x, y, w, h, fill, deckle, seed, shadow, stroke}) -> piece {el, art, body, path, shadow}

validation.evidence: Kit self-test tests/test-mythic.py (Playwright Chromium: build, seek determinism) and frame review of the mythic-film scaffold (portrait) on Windows, 2026-11-23. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
